title: skills(objectstack-ai): the "two AgentSchema keys are tombstones" paragraph is stale — agent.tools / agent.knowledge aged out at protocol 18 and its agent.zod.ts:234, :251 citation points at nothing
body:
epic:#5055#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMmczBEaeiAQ48oDtz

Filing gate: ② review finding follow-up · Source: contract review of objectstack-ai/objectstack#37765 (card #37711), finding S1 (should-fix), outside that PR's claimed surface and pre-existing.
Grade: p3 · domain:skills · Task · evidence: read (`main` `agent.zod.ts`, `agent.test.ts`)
Reader: domain:skills lane.
Dedupe: searched open issues for the paragraph and the citation: none.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：AI 技能文档里有一段说 agent 的 `tools` / `knowledge` 两个旧字段是「墓碑」（写了会报错并给迁移提示），还引用了 schema 的两个行号。那两个墓碑在协议 18 就已经撤掉了，现在只是普通的「未知字段」报错，行号也早就对不上。
- 影响：AI 照文档写会得到正确的报错，只是文档描述的报错方式和行号不对。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What is wrong
`skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` (~`:453-455` on main) says "Two `AgentSchema` keys are **tombstones** … authoring either is a parse error carrying its migration (`packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts:234, :251`)". On `main`:
- `agent.zod.ts:234` is a blank line and `:251` is inside `checkAgentMemoryContract`; there is no `tools` or `knowledge` key or `retiredKey()` for either in the file.
- `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.test.ts:115-121` and `:248-258`: both tombstones "aged out at 18 with its kit (#25767)"; `AgentSchema` is a `strictObject`, so either key is refused as an unrecognized key whose message names the upgrade guide.

## What to do
Rewrite the paragraph (and its table header, "REMOVED in protocol 17") to teach what `main` does: both keys are refused as unknown keys by the strict `AgentSchema`, the refusal names `https://objectstack.ai/docs/protocol-upgrade`, and their replacements (skills for tools, the table's knowledge prescription) stay as taught. Cite the test or the strict-object refusal, not stale line numbers. The file sits at its token ceiling (6801/6801 after #37765), so pay for the words in the same section.

## Acceptance
- Every `agent.zod.ts` / `agent.test.ts` citation in the section matches `main`; skills gates green.
